# StreamingText

Plain text that is typed out while it streams in: new text is revealed at a steady pace that follows the
arrival of the chunks, instead of appearing in blocks. Line breaks and spaces are kept. For replies that contain
Markdown use Markdown.

**Interaction**: not interactive. Text present when it mounts is shown at once; only text that arrives later is
typed out, and a character is never shown half-built (emoji, accented letters). While `streaming`, a static
cursor marks the end and the element is `aria-busy`. When the stream ends, the rest of the text appears at once.
With "reduce motion" on, the text is shown as it arrives, without typing.

**Category**: AI · **Common uses**: Streaming plain-text replies, generated titles and summaries, live transcripts

## Import

```ts
import { StreamingText } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Pass the text received so far and `streaming` while more is coming: new text is typed out at a steady pace and a
cursor marks the end. Line breaks are kept.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  const reply = useStream({
    request: (signal) => readSSE(fakeSSE(SUMMARY, { signal, chunk: 6, interval: 80 }), { signal }),
    initial: '',
    reduce: appendDelta,
  })
  const streaming = reply.status === 'streaming'
  return (
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <Inline gap={2}>
        {streaming ? (
          <Button onClick={reply.stop}>Stop</Button>
        ) : (
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => reply.start()}>
            Summarize
          </Button>
        )}
      </Inline>
      <StreamingText text={reply.value || 'Press "Summarize" to start.'} streaming={streaming} />
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## States

### Finished text

Without `streaming` the text is shown at once and there is no cursor, for example when a conversation is opened
again later.

```tsx
export function Finished() {
  return <StreamingText text={SUMMARY} />
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` | The text received so far. It grows while the stream runs; line breaks are kept. | — | Yes |
| `streaming` | `boolean` | More text is coming: the new text is typed out and a cursor is shown at the end. When it becomes `false`, the rest of the text appears at once and the cursor goes away. | `false` | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
